details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (profit decline, ROE, cost-to-income), K2 (loan portfolio growth), K3 (customer deposits), K4 (customer base growth), K6 (bond issuance and EIB guarantee), K10 (dividends), and K11 (EEEF subordinated loan). However, it omits the strategic targets of K5, the capital ratios and regulatory compliance details of K7, the sustainability initiatives of K8, the new services and products of K9, and the management board appointment of K12. While several HIGH importance criteria are missing, the main financial performance picture is captured, justifying a 'Generally yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. It presents a consistent narrative where declining profitability (S1-S2, S21) is logically explained by lower interest rates and margins (S3-S4), partially offset by modest fee income growth (S6) and improved other income (S7). The summary clearly links higher operating costs (S8-S9) to the rising cost-to-income ratio (S10). Balance sheet growth metrics (S13-S17) are presented as separate positive developments that do not contradict the profitability decline. All relationships between causes and effects are logically consistent, and the summary forms a coherent whole without contradictions or unnecessary repetition. The final overview in S24 successfully integrates all discussed elements.
